description: Hi! We’re graduate students at Nanyang Technological University interested in planetary exploration and interactive mapping. We’re building Marswalk, a web-based field-planning concept for a crew route from Bradbury Landing to Pahrump Hills, using NASA Mars imagery, elevation, and thermal-inertia layers. We welcome teammates with skills in web development, GIS, UI/UX, or science communication to help refine the map and present it clearly.
summary: Marswalk is an interactive map concept for planning a crewed field study near Pahrump Hills at the base of Mount Sharp in Gale Crater. It brings together NASA Mars imagery, regional elevation, and thermal-inertia layers so users can explore the mission area, compare scientific context, and inspect route stops. The map also distinguishes a proposed crew concept route from Curiosity's historical traverse. Marswalk is an educational planning prototype, not a validated crew navigation or safety system. It helps make planetary surface data easier to explore while showing what additional high-resolution terrain and hazard information a real mission would need.
details:
Marswalk is a lightweight web interface built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Leaflet. Users can toggle CTX and HiRISE optical imagery, a MOLA elevation layer, and a TES thermal-inertia layer; adjust overlay opacity; show or hide route markers; and select Bradbury Landing or Pahrump Hills to read mission notes. A separate toggle displays Curiosity's historical traverse for comparison with the illustrative crew route.

The project focuses on an accessible field-planning workflow: see the regional setting, review geological context, and identify observations that a crew might make at an outcrop. The route is conceptual and has not been validated against fine-scale slope, loose sand, obstacles, radiation forecasts, or other operational hazards. MOLA is used only for regional context. Radiation and space-weather information are explanatory references, not live feeds or mission-day forecasts.

Source code: https://github.com/GrannyYY/marswalk-field-planner
